item.tib: zhi khro rdzu 'phrul dra ba dbal chen po gshed dmar spyi 'dul las srid pa rab 'byams kyi mdos bskang
item.coloph: rab 'byams srid pa'i kha skong zhes bya ba/ 'chi med gtsug phud kyi lung don/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i brnag pa/ stag la me 'bar gyis gtan la phab pa rdzogs so/ de nas lha klu mi gsum snang mdog dang bzhi nas/ gyer spung dran pa nam mkha'i lung don/ de nas stang dmu tsha gyer med la brgyud do//
